lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The yard has gone quiet. I can show you where the work stopped.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Nothing comes from the ridge while that thing is there.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The water channel could keep us working, if someone opened it.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The patrol cleared the ridge before you returned.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The ridge is clear. Route A is feeding the yard again.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The channel is open. We can work again, though the ridge is still unsafe.

lines.speaker: witness
lines.text: The factory is gone. Mara still waits elsewhere — the work cannot resume here.
